messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: 2027-05-16 08:15 PDT
Subject: Forecast clarity sprint — account asks + 15m pre-call checklist

Team — quick cadence for today’s forecast submission. We have a tight window before EOD turn-in, so please do a rapid sweep on the accounts you own and confirm the one-line commit and evidence link. I’m booking a 15-minute pre-call at 10:45 to triage anything that’s not commit-ready.

Agenda (10m pre-call + 5m admin):
- Quick state: Commit / Upside / No-go (one line) per owner
- Evidence check: Pricing memo, PO/Procurement readiness, SOC2 attestation tile
- Blockers & escalation requests (if revenue > $50k MRR)

Asks before the 10:45: 1) update HubSpot deal stage to "Commit Review" and paste the evidence link; 2) attach the completed forecast-evidence-template.xlsx to the deal (stub attached here); 3) mark any legal/procurement hold in the deal notes.

I’ll kick the pre-call and run a two-account deep triage if needed. If you expect to move an account from Upside to Commit during the call, drop a short note in the thread with the change and reason.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Revenue Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
